threads.body: [Testing] The Undertow assertion covers exception-name fallback only on a server span. The shared client/server extractor tests pass no response status for exceptions, and the duration-metric tests inject `ERROR_TYPE` directly. They therefore do not protect custom classification after successful headers or propagation of the extracted error into metrics. Please add shared client/server Instrumenter regressions for HTTP 200 plus a terminal exception, asserting the preserved status code and matching `error.type` on exported spans and duration points. Cover custom classification before exception fallback, and an error HTTP status retaining precedence over both.
